focus_area_title: Seek Out Diversity and Celebrate It
content_text_body:
The power of diversity can lead the way to enhance collective intelligence and performance in a
team, and that's definitely worth celebrating!

### Act on it
Create experiences that support a sense of diversity and embrace a culture that fosters respect
for individuality. The act of recognizing the uniqueness of your team members gives you an
opportunity to understand and appreciate their views and identities.

### Learn from different people
Give yourself the opportunity to connect with people from other cultures or groups. These
interactions will help you to move from avoiding differences to understanding multiple
perspectives and dynamics.

### Celebrate it
Identify individual strengths and celebrate them! Establish the habit of honoring your colleagues
by highlighting the unique experience, skills, and knowledge they bring into the team.

Learn more about [why diversity matters](https://www.forbes.com/sites/shelleyzalis/2017/11/30/the-truth-about-diversity-and-why-it-matters/#6c7a29c166e7).
